items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was over there with Johnny Carson. I subbed on the Carson show with Skitch Henderson.

ctx.x: This was a couple times before Clark went on staff, he and Snooky Young. Then I was over there with Johnny Carson. I subbed on the Carson show with Skitch Henderson. So it’s funny that I had done The Tonight Show from – with everybody that was on there. It’s kind of amusing.
And now Wynton Marsalis’s brother is leading the band over there, Branford Marsalis.
